title: Face-to-face signing of US-Iran deal 'up in the air' after Trump's Versailles signing
summary: The US-Iran deal was initially meant to be signed in Switzerland on Friday before US President Donald Trump decided to sign it in the palace of Versailles at a state dinner with French President Emmanuel Macron Wednesday night. But Switzerland has confirmed that talks on the implementation of the deal are still set to happen on June 19 in Geneva. FRANCE 24'…
